text:
Mia: Heads-up — AcmeRetail renewal in 28 days and onboarding has basically stalled. Usage dropped 60% this week after they hit errors on batch embeddings. Need a short recovery + downgrade-safe plan.
Devin: Thanks Mia. Can you share the last onboarding notes and the exact error? I can pull logs and a usage snapshot.
Mia: Pasted error they saw: `rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded` during embedding job. Happened 3/4 runs. Logs: link to internal dashboard (internal-only).
Sam: I can run a 30m targeted enablement session next Tue — walk through batching config and KV cache use. @Mia can you confirm who from their team will join?
Henry: I spoke with their CFO earlier — budget anxiety. They asked if they can temporarily drop to the lower-tier model to keep feature access while lowering spend.
Mia: Proposed quick plan (draft):
  1) Immediate: Triage call (today) to collect logs & reproduction steps — owner: Devin.
  2) Short-term: Offer temporary downgrade to smaller model variant + throttled reserved bursts for 2 weeks. Provide a cost delta and rollback path. Owner: Henry/Henry to draft terms.
  3) Enablement: 30m workshop on batching & prefix caching; sample prompt set + config before/after. Owner: Sam.
  4) Measurement: baseline usage + SLA of success criteria (activation events X2/week, <10% error rate). Owner: Mia.
  5) Feedback capture: quick NPS + 3-question survey post-workshop; add notes to CRM. Owner: Devin.
Devin: I can run a short query to export their last 14 days of tokens, error types, and average latency. Will also attach the small SQL snippet I use.
Devin: ```sql
SELECT date, env, error_type, count(*) as cnt
FROM infra.events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme-retail'
AND date >= current_date - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY date desc;
```
Mia: Love it. Henry — can you draft the downgrade terms today? Keep it 2-week temporary discount, auto-revert unless they opt in. Also include the rollback steps (model pin version, capacity change).
Henry: Yep, will post a short email template in this thread by EOD.
Sam: Heads-up on workshop content: I'll include a short pre-config checklist and 3 short demos (batching, KV caching, model choice tradeoffs). Will also record the session and drop a 5-slide summary.
cs-bot: Reminder — create a renewal watchlist flag (tag: renewal-risk) for acme-retail.
Mia: OK all — owners: Devin(triage/logs), Henry(terms), Sam(enablement), Mia(measure + followup). I'll schedule triage call for today 4pm PT. If that works for everyone, I'll DM invites. :thumbsup:
Sam: Works for me.
Henry: I can make 4pm.
Devin: I'll be there.
Mia: After triage, we ship a one-pager with: one-sentence problem, what we did, timeframe, and a recommended downgrade path + rollback. Keep it <200 words. That will go to finance + their sponsor.
Mia: Also — quick ask: if we have to roll them back to older model variant, we should record quality-impact notes in the ticket so we can correlate with downstream metrics. Use tag `quality-delta`.
Devin: Noted. I'll add fields to the ticket template.
Mia: Thanks team — will update thread after 4pm call. :rocket:
